payload.body_they: {{Name}} often learns what they want most clearly when a partner wants something different. Disagreement makes it obvious where they are willing to compromise and where they are not. The complication comes when the relationship starts organizing itself around whichever person pushes harder. Conflict can reveal what both people want without deciding who automatically gets their way. The relationship works better when both people can have a direction of their own.
